title: Defensive programming: perturber bounds enforcement
description:
CRITICAL: Perturber language has unbounded iteration vectors.

1. Python repeat count unbounded — range(billion) causes DoS
2. for_each collection size unbounded (both Rust and Python) — nested for_each creates exponential blowup
3. Rust counter addition uses unchecked i64 arithmetic — silent overflow corruption
4. Python counter value unbounded — arbitrary precision int exhausts memory

Fix: Add MAX_REPEAT (10_000), MAX_FOREACH_ITEMS (10_000), checked_add for counters, bounds on counter values. Both engines.
close_reason: MAX_REPEAT, MAX_FOREACH_ITEMS, MAX_COUNTER_VALUE, checked_add, MAX_CEL_LENGTH, MAX_CEL_GRID_CELLS. Both engines.
